title: Bird Bend Stand bring-up assistant: step definitions (D-56 a, SRS SW-BRU-001)
description: Data file shipped with the application (bend_stand/resources/bringup_steps.json). Content is authored from the delivered bring-up guide (same step ids); the engine (core/bringup.py) adds semantic checks: unique ids, known sections, known action ids, known condition sources / keys / ops, kind-specific params.

file.description: guide file name in the delivery package

send_to.description: text of the package dialog: whom to send the zip to

optional.description: may be skipped without counting as missing (still needs a reason)

stop_if_fail.description: the guide says STOP when this step fails

safety.description: safety note shown with the step

hg.description: overlap with a formal HW-gate item (same check, not gate evidence)

motion.description: the step moves the axis (its motion is recorded; default true for kinds motion / pulse_integrity / travel_cal wizard)

action.description: GUI action id (bringup_dock.ACTIONS, 'show:<tab>') or the engine action 'pulse_integrity'

params.description: kind-specific parameters (wizard: wizard; pulse_integrity: baseline_homes, baseline_max_um, round_trips, from_mm, to_mm, speed_mm_s (number), d_floor_um, d_factor, repeats_allowed, home_event_timeout_s, fail_text, baseline_fail_text)

pass_values.description: choice / text values that PASS; any other entered value makes the step FAIL

required_when.description: the field is required only while one of these entry conditions holds (overrides 'required')

invalid_when.description: entry rules: the entered value (or one of 'values') is refused with 'text' while one of the 'when' conditions holds

values.description: only these entered values are refused (default: any value)

entry_condition.description: an operator entry of this step ('field') or of another step ('step' + 'field') compared with 'value'

arm.description: select (default): evaluation starts when the step is selected; action: when its engine action starts

text.description: shown while waiting for this stage

min_s.description: the conditions must hold continuously for at least this time

value.description: literal, or {"$const": NAME} (PARAM_DICT_HASH, PROTO_MAJOR, PROTO_MINOR, PAYLOAD_VERSION, ICD_VERSION, SW_VERSION) or {"$param": key} (board value)

path.description: src step: dotted field of the other step's record (default 'state'; e.g. 'action.result.verdict', 'entries.u_ena', 'origin')

label.description: text of the observation in the automatic result
